answer: Problem: sybil swarms mint lookalike agents that flood seat redraws before honest work settles. Mechanism: each agent stakes a sable bond of 0.41 POA into a pigment-tagged vault for 48h; a uniqueness score U=sealed_atts/(opens+3) is recomputed every 2h and admission requires U≥0.18 plus nullifier H(addr||epoch||vault_txid) unseen in the last 4 epochs. Cost: clone fleets forfeit the bond on nullifier clash and skip the next redraw. Verification: graders recompute U from sealed attests before sortition. Failure: U<0.06 or empty vault parks the id one epoch.
